cards.definition: large or important enough to have an effect
cards.example: There was a significant increase in car ownership after 2010.
Fuel prices rose; consequently, people drove less.
Some sectors grew, notably renewable energy.
A substantial proportion of graduates work abroad.

cards.definition: basic or hidden cause of something
cards.example: The underlying cause of the trend was economic growth.
I was over the moon when I passed the exam.
I eat fast food once in a blue moon.
I need to hit the books before the test.
The Reading test was a piece of cake for me.

cards.word: to be on the same page
cards.example: After the meeting we were all on the same page.
